rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for describing an inspired, hopeful, or happier mood.

example.english: I felt uplifted when I heard everyone's support.
example.traditional: 聽到大家支持我，我覺得好振奮。
example.jyutping: ting1 dou2 daai6 gaa1 zi1 ci4 ngo5 ngo5 gok3 dak1 hou2 zan3 fan5

rows.note: Use this for land or another physical area that has risen into a bulge.

example.english: The middle of this road is uplifted, so be careful.
example.traditional: 呢段路中間隆起咗，小心啲。
example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 lou6 zung1 gaan1 lung4 hei2 zo2 siu2 sam1 di1
